take.en: Agent workflow that turns docs or a topic into a real editable PowerPoint — native shapes, charts, masters, not a flat PDF fake.

explanation.en: PPT Master is an open-source skill-style pipeline you run with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or any agent that can read files and run commands. You drop in a PDF, DOCX, URL, or a plain brief; it structures the argument, designs slides, and exports a true .pptx. Elements stay native PowerPoint objects with adjustment handles, data-backed charts and tables when you want them, slide masters and layouts on the structured path, plus optional transitions, animations, speaker notes, and narration audio.

why.en: Founders still live in decks for investors, customers, and internal alignment. Most AI slide tools give you locked layouts or image-filled shells that die the moment you need to edit in PowerPoint. This one keeps data on your machine, works with the model you already pay for, and hands you a file your team can keep refining without a second SaaS bill.

howItWorks.en: Install Python 3.10+, clone the repo, pip install requirements, open the folder in your agent tool, and ask it to build a deck from your material. The agent drives the project workflows on disk: research and outline, visual design, export. You can also distill brand templates from reference decks, fill an existing .pptx while keeping design, or layer narration onto a finished deck. Preview examples live on the project site before you run anything local.

different.en: The bet is depth in PowerPoint’s object model, not prettier screenshots. Editable is table stakes; PPT Master aims at real shapes, charts, masters, and motions so the AI output keeps converging with what you would build by hand in PowerPoint.
